title: Which modelling choices are supported when marine survey data are limited? Code, data and results
description:
Code and data for: Afrifa-Yamoah, E., Siqueira, A. C., Awuah-Mensah, Y. K., Fouedjio, F. and Mueller, U. (2026). Which modelling choices are supported when marine survey data are limited? An evidence map of 95 studies and a benchmark on structured subsamples of a trawl survey. Preprint, EcoEvoRxiv, https://doi.org/10.32942/X2JM49.

The repository holds the evidence map coding sheet and the script that draws the map; the benchmark scaffold that draws structured subsamples from the NWFSC West Coast Groundfish Bottom Trawl Survey (via the surveyjoin R package), fits five species distribution models to each subsample and evaluates them against the held out survey; the analysis and figure scripts; the result tables and figures from the 10 replicates per cell run; and the Supporting Information.

R code is released under the MIT licence. Figures, the coding sheet and the Supporting Information are released under CC BY 4.0. Survey data are not redistributed.
